capabilities: Insert a link to a dragged Outlook email
Insert a link to a dragged Outlook folder
Place several dragged emails on separate lines
Open links in the Outlook app on Windows
Customize link templates and email and folder URLs
extras: Makes no network requests and needs no sign-in; on Windows it runs PowerShell and Edge's msedge_proxy.exe to open links in the Outlook app. Installable with BRAT. Not affiliated with Microsoft.
problem: A note that refers to an Outlook email has no easy way to link back to that specific message or folder.

relations.evidence: Drag an email from Outlook on the web, or the Outlook app installed from it (PWA), onto a note.

requires.name: Outlook on the web or the Outlook app (PWA)
Microsoft Edge, to open links in the Outlook app on Windows

summary: Turns emails and folders dragged from Outlook on the web into Markdown links that reopen them in Outlook.
